bio: Son of Catherine Heffernan and Edmund Grimes; killed in a mine accident at the Boston D&H colliery in 1909 (W-B Times-Leader 17 Apr 1909). His brother Edmund D. Grimes died in a California mine accident in 1927 (Evening News 16 Apr 1927).
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh
